value.summary: This pull request refactors the `openhuman_core` import paths, adds round-based turn authorization to the hivemind episode loop (replacing sequential single-turn steps with a round of turns committed atomically), and updates tests and documentation to match. The import changes are mechanical path adjustments; the hivemind changes introduce a new concurrency model where multiple turns are authorized together but run serially. All tests compile and the existing behaviour for width-1 rounds is preserved. The change looks sound.
